description: Item 2: automate as much of the 7-item manual checklist as is machine-provable, labelled SIMULATED/AUTOMATED and NOT a substitute for the human M01-UI sign-off. Headless frame matrix (min 560x286, 559x286, 720x480, 719x479, 899/900/first-dock-width boundary found by sweep, ultra-wide, tall-narrow, simulated 150% via pixels_per_point), audit-only OM9_UI_AUDIT_ZOOM for real-window DPI simulation, a Python launcher for a real-window matrix with screenshots, and a shortened checklist in OM9-L4-01-01-002-05.ui-review.json. Depends on FEAT-001 (asserts the status text does not overlap).
steps: Create standalone/crates/om9-app/tests/workbench_regions_sizes.rs (helpers copied from tests/workbench_regions.rs). check_frame asserts: plan.validate() ok, 4 non-overlapping view_rects inside plan.center (8 px tolerance), command_input_rect Some, inside plan.command_input and intersecting no view, status message/summary rects not overlapping, all rects finite and inside the screen. Sizes: 560x286 ok; 559x286 and 560x285 -> WindowTooSmall with Error status starting 'Layout:', last good plan kept, dock JSON/workspace/entity count unchanged; 720x480 and 719x479; sweep widths 700..1100 step 1 with the Layers dock to find the first width with plan.right_dock Some, then assert absent at first-1, present at first, NarrowWindow note below 900, NotEnoughRoom between 900 and first-1, and explicit 899/900/901; 5120x1440, 2560x600, 720x2000, 720x1300; AppConfig::interactive with a window below min_window fails validate() with a StartupFailure.

Same file: simulated 150%: context.set_pixels_per_point(1.5) with screen_rect = physical/1.5 for 1600x1000, 1280x800, 800x600, 1440x960 (right dock). Doc-comment states honestly that egui lays out in points so this proves point-space layout and rounding at 1.5, not OS per-monitor DPI.

Same file: hidden command line test: app.dock.set_visible(PanelId::CommandLine,false) and app.toggle_right_dock(); command_input_rect stays Some, plan notes contain CommandInputKept, notice in CMD history. First grep ui.rs and ui/chrome.rs for any menu entry that hides the command line; if none, say in the test doc and checklist that this is driven through the layout API.

Same file (only if achievable without native dialogs, patterns in tests/command_sessions.rs, tests/cold_reopen.rs, tests/file_lifecycle.rs): run a Line command, Undo, Redo, save to a temp .om9 and reopen; assert region_plan equal before and after at the same window size. If not achievable, leave checklist item 5 human-only and record the reason in findings.

In ui.rs launch_with add audit-only OM9_UI_AUDIT_ZOOM: only when app.audit is Some; parse finite value in [0.5, 4.0] else StartupFailure (same style as OM9_UI_AUDIT_WINDOW); call cc.egui_ctx.set_zoom_factor(zoom) in the run_native closure before the first frame. Add unit tests next to parse_window_size. Add zoom_factor, pixels_per_point and screen_points to the receipt regions block.

Create tools/validate_m01_l3_002_ui_matrix.py modelled on tools/validate_standalone_ui.py (record the Rust-first exception: launcher for a real GPU window, no logic). Args --binary (default standalone/target/debug/om9.exe), --output. Cases (real windows): min-720x480, boundary-899x700, boundary-first-1 and first (width from the sweep result), ultrawide-2560x600, tall-narrow-720x1300, normal-1600x1000, narrow-800x600, dpi150-1600x1000 and dpi150-1280x800 (OM9_UI_AUDIT_ZOOM=1.5, labelled SIMULATED). Each run in a temp profile under build/standalone-validation; require exit 0, regions.error null, 4 views, no overlap, command input present, status_text_overlap false, expected right-dock state; write matrix-summary.json (case, env, exit code, receipt and screenshot SHA-256, pixels_per_point actually reported). List below-minimum sizes as frame-test-only. Build first with cargo build -p om9-app.

Run the runner into build/standalone-validation/ui-artifacts/<date>-m01-l3-002-closeout/matrix/. Open and describe at least min-720x480, a boundary case, ultrawide, tall-narrow and dpi150-1600x1000 screenshots; only claim images you opened.

Refresh implementation/evidence/M01/OM9-L3-01-01-002/OM9-L4-01-01-002-05.ui-review.json: add automated_simulated_evidence (label 'SIMULATED/AUTOMATED - does not replace human M01-UI sign-off', cases, commands, exit codes, screenshot paths); replace manual_reviewer_checklist.items with at most 6 items, each with machine_proven, human_must_verify, reviewer_decision null (real 150% scaling and second monitor; live drag-resize; hide command line/right dock via menu; command/Undo/Redo/save/reopen; read the bottom status line at 800x600 and 720x480). Keep reviewer.status NOT_SIGNED, name/date null, gate.m01_ui OPEN, gate.m00 NOT_SIGNED, gate.legal_reuse PENDING_HUMAN_M00_APPROVAL. Update not_captured and remaining; keep the old status-text defect string as previous_defect_fixed_in_closeout. Validate JSON parses.
acceptance_criteria: cargo test -p om9-app --test workbench_regions_sizes passes and covers every listed size, the boundary sweep, the simulated 1.5 scale, and the hidden-command-line case.
tools/validate_m01_l3_002_ui_matrix.py exits 0, matrix-summary.json lists every case with exit code 0 and hashes; every cited screenshot was opened.
ui-review.json: reviewer.status still NOT_SIGNED, gates unchanged, checklist at most 6 items each split into machine_proven and human_must_verify, all automated evidence labelled SIMULATED/AUTOMATED.
Nothing in the repo or docs claims 150% DPI, second monitor or live drag were verified by a human.
No commit, no staging, no private-tree edits.
verification: cd h:\OpenMatrix9\standalone ; cargo test -p om9-app --test workbench_regions_sizes
cd h:\OpenMatrix9\standalone ; cargo test -p om9-app ; cargo fmt --all -- --check ; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
cd h:\OpenMatrix9 ; python tools\validate_m01_l3_002_ui_matrix.py (after cargo build -p om9-app) exits 0

cd h:\OpenMatrix9 ; python -c "import json;d=json.load(open('implementation/evidence/M01/OM9-L3-01-01-002/OM9-L4-01-01-002-05.ui-review.json',encoding='utf-8'));assert d['reviewer']['status']=='NOT_SIGNED' and d['gate']['m01_ui']=='OPEN'"
findings: Done, uncommitted, all labelled SIMULATED/AUTOMATED. SWEEP: first dock width = 915 pt (Layers docked right, height 800; 914 absent/NotEnoughRoom, 900..914 NotEnoughRoom, <900 NarrowWindow); real windows at 914x700 and 915x700 agree. TESTS: tests/workbench_regions_sizes.rs 10 passed (prints 'OM9_SWEEP first_dock_width=915' with --nocapture); ui.rs lib tests 62 (was 61, +audit_zoom parse test); full cargo test -j 1 -p om9-app exit 0 (log build/standalone-validation/feat002-om9-app-test.log: workbench_regions 8, status_bar_overlap 4, shell_docking 10); fmt --check and clippy --workspace --all-targets -D warnings exit 0. CODE: ui.rs gained parse_zoom_factor and audit-only OM9_UI_AUDIT_ZOOM (0.5..4.0, else Error::Io -> StartupFailure Renderer, applied with set_zoom_factor in run_native closure only when app.audit is Some) and receipt regions.zoom_factor, pixels_per_point, screen_points. RUNNER: python tools/validate_m01_l3_002_ui_matrix.py (Rust-first exception recorded in its docstring and in the ui-review json) exit 0, 10 cases all PASS exit 0, status_text_overlap false, regions.error null, 4 views; reported ppp 1.0 (1.5 for dpi150 cases); screenshots == requested physical size. SCREENSHOTS: build/standalone-validation/ui-artifacts/2026-10-16-m01-l3-002-closeout/matrix/<case>/{workspace.png,ui-receipt.json} + matrix-summary.json; opened and described: min-720x480, boundary-914x700, boundary-915x700, ultrawide-2560x600, tall-narrow-720x1300, dpi150-1600x1000 (not opened: boundary-899x700, normal-1600x1000 matrix copy, narrow-800x600 matrix copy, dpi150-1280x800). CHECKLIST (ui-review.json refreshed, 5 items, reviewer NOT_SIGNED, gates unchanged): machine-proven = discrete sizes/boundary, simulated 1.5, hidden command line via layout API (no menu entry exists for the command line), status line rects, command/Undo/Redo/save/reopen plan equality; human-only = real OS DPI + second monitor, live drag, menu path for dock, native Save/Open dialogs in the real window, readability judgement. Checklist item 5 (command, Undo, Redo, save, reopen) WAS automatable via Controller APIs (begin_file_operation/accept_file_path, no native dialog). DEFECTS RECORDED, NOT FIXED: (1) saving a document containing a Line fails Invalid('archive encoding verification') in om9-archive (Point saves fine), so the test saves a Point document; (2) at heights < 311 px the plan clamps command panel to 58 but egui draws the stored taller panel (28 px gap at 560x286, unreachable since OS min is 480); the test only asserts the vertical containment when the plan is not clamped; at normal sizes the input line ends ~3 px past the plan panel (tolerance 8). Also 800x600 @1.5 = 533x400 pt is below the 560x286 minimum (reported as Layout error in the frame test; not a runner case). FEAT-003 should list: new/changed files ui.rs, tests/workbench_regions_sizes.rs, tools/validate_m01_l3_002_ui_matrix.py, ui-review.json, FEAT-002.json (plus FEAT-001 files); mention the Line-save defect in the final report; business rule unchanged except the audit-only OM9_UI_AUDIT_ZOOM env var (not a business rule). Nothing committed or staged; ref, manuals, OM9_Milestones, QymCAD untouched.
